page.notes: The first word "he:" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Reading of several Greek words is uncertain, marked [?]: διαπορήσεως, πεποιθήσεως, ἐπαινετῆς, προτροπῇ, and "fide" (the initial letter could be s). The small dashes and daggers at the left margin line starts are printer's marks, not text. Printed "absolui-tur" and "conclufio" were normalised to s and u as per the rules. Printed text "vt" changed to "ut".
